summary: Reuse generation-keyed sealed fleet membership views across client and replication reads (#2444).

replay.detail: No claim replay or fleet membership fold changes; the cache reuses the sealed view at the same fleet generation.

schema.detail: Normal store open installs complete fleet-generation triggers for claim, batch, envelope, signature, and anchor fold inputs, replacing older narrow update triggers. Adds the covering claims_batch_kind index for bounded trigger predicates. No schema-version change, claim rewrite, or persistent view cache; older builds retain the additive index and triggers.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or digest rule changes and no coordinated fleet upgrade required.

compatibility.detail: Fleet status and membership JSON retain their existing fields and sealed-reader semantics; sharing the view does not change client or peer protocols.

downtime.detail: Normal daemon restart. First open builds claims_batch_kind over existing claims before serving requests; startup duration and index size were not measured.

manual.detail: No configuration or store repair steps required.

recovery.detail: The cache is process-local and discarded on restart; normal binary rollback remains unchanged.
